title: OpenAI Revenue Shocks AI Plays | Chipotle Jumps on Takeover Rumors
speaker: Drew Dosik

macro_themes.view: OpenAI cut revenue to $50B from $70B expected, hitting AI plays, but accounting differences make it less bad than feared.
10-year yield may be putting in a weekly topping tail; lower yields would help small and mid caps.
Administration likely wants oil lower before midterms, so no big oil rally until after early November.

calls.condition: above ~775 neckline turns near-term bullish; further selling targets gap fill support ~764
calls.reason: SPY closed under the 775.21 inverse head-and-shoulders neckline, putting the pattern in jeopardy, but prior one-day breaks recovered.
calls.quote: anything over 775 and change starts putting investors back in near-term bullish mode, cuz that 10-year yield did come down, too.

calls.reason: Recovered off lows and broke a small consolidation, but hourly QQQ shows a bear flag implying lower; gap fill near rising trendline from March lows is support.
calls.quote: that's a downward move in a bear flag on the QQQ. So, that implies we still could be coming down lower.

calls.reason: Pierced and recovered at former resistance turned support (0.618 fib); hasn't broken down, consolidating in a range.
calls.quote: So, so far, SMH hasn't necessarily broken down.

calls.condition: needs to close the week at or below 5.28% to confirm weekly topping tail
calls.reason: Consecutive daily topping tails and a potential weekly topping tail suggest yields turn lower, helping small caps.
calls.quote: there's more of these wicks developing at the top of the chart, specifically recently, implying the direction is likely to start changing to move lower.

calls.reason: Gold still in a bearish consolidation, chopping sideways without new lows.
calls.quote: Still in a bearish consolidation that does imply we could see more downside unless, of course, those 10-year yields continue to start declining

calls.condition: daily close below 50% of the parallel channel kicks off selling to the 53.26 head-and-shoulders target; buys at $50-53
calls.reason: Bear flag breaking and head-and-shoulders neckline break with measured move to 53.26; plans to buy in the 50-53 zone.
calls.quote: where I am going to be picking up silver once we get around the 53 and $50 range on silver.

calls.reason: Still an inside-bar bull flag holding former resistance as support; expects a test of the head-and-shoulders neckline at 89,500.
calls.quote: we're anticipating price to come back up and test that neckline on the chart of Bitcoin.

calls.reason: Oil sitting in a bear flag since Sept 21; Trump walked back attack talk and administration likely wants lower oil before midterms.
calls.quote: I'm really not seeing oil rocket up on this chart until we get past that first week in November.

calls.condition: will nibble if nat gas dips further
calls.reason: Nat gas in breakout territory; sold BOIL at highs and waiting to buy a dip, expecting a move back toward the weekly parallel bottom at $3.59.
calls.quote: Waiting for another opportunity to buy cuz I still anticipate nat gas to go up higher on the charts.

calls.condition: if selling continues to the 0.382 fib at ~246.96 by October 14, bounce play
calls.reason: Long bull flag since September; 0.382 fib plus rising trendline is an X-marks-the-spot bounce level.
calls.quote: if we do see some continued selling in the next couple days, I see that being an area for a near-term bounce play on BE.

calls.condition: selling through 214 could run to just under 205
calls.reason: Near-term breakdown from trendline off July pivot low; next support at top of parallel channel 214.
calls.quote: Now, where is the next level of support? Pretty evident right here on top of the parallel channel at $214.

calls.condition: close above ~$33.50 back into the channel is near-term positive
calls.reason: Popped 6.21% on Starbucks takeover rumor but still below the broken parallel channel that keeps rejecting it.
calls.quote: Be watching around $33.50. Getting above that and closing would be near-term positive on Chipotle.

calls.reason: Oversold bounce off a $30 support zone where the 0.786 fib and a flipped horizontal trendline line up.
calls.quote: A bounce of this nature could take Rollins all the way back up here to 3583

notes: Only 'Thursday' stated; listing date used. ROL target quoted as '3583' read as 35.83. NQ gap-fill level 28,867 quoted though above the stated low of 27,069; recorded as given. BE target garbled ('236, 240 or 268'); 268 used.
